United States Department of the Interior
BUREAU OF OUTDOOR RECREATION
LAKE CENTRAL REGION
3853 RESEARCH PARK DRIVE
ANN ARBOR, MICHIGAN 48106
M2253 Illinois ER 72/473
November 7, 1974
Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski District Engineer, District 1 Illinois Department of Transportation Room 907, 300 North State Street Chicago, Illinois 60610
Dear Mr. Ziejewski:
This is in response to your request for our opinion relative to the applicability of Section 4(f) to the Roosevelt School property, F.A. Route 23 (U.S. 30) Lincoln Highway, Cook County, Illinois. We regret the delay in our response.
The enclosed copy of correspondence from Benjamin O. Davis, Jr., Department of Transportation to Bruce Blanchard, Department of the Interior, would appear to provide an answer to your request. In this regard, the proper person to make a determination of recreation significance would be Mr. Robert Lueder, Director of the Park District for Chicago Heights, Illinois.
At this time our opinion corresponds with that of Mr. Davis. However, our opinion is provided on the basis of technical assistance and does not necessarily represent the position of the Department of the Interior.
Sincerely yours,
John D. Cherry
Regional Director
